note: This file is a pure configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It defines dataset settings, data pipelines, dataloaders, and evaluators for the MOT Challenge dataset in MMDetection.
summarize_mot_challenge_config: summarize the MOT Challenge dataset config including train and test pipelines
review_train_pipeline: review the train_pipeline transforms including UniformRefFrameSample and TransformBroadcaster
review_test_pipeline: review the test_pipeline transforms including Resize and LoadTrackAnnotations
review_train_dataloader: review the train_dataloader settings including TrackImgSampler and MOTChallengeDataset
review_val_evaluator: review the val_evaluator MOTChallengeMetric with HOTA CLEAR and Identity metrics
